list.name: group
list.label: Global Collection
list.query: SELECT gc_name AS __text, gc_rec_ID AS __value FROM reporting.globalcollection ORDER BY gc_name
list.definition: SELECT gc_name AS __text, gc_rec_ID AS __value FROM reporting.globalcollection ORDER BY gc_name

list.name: devices
list.label: Devices
list.query: SELECT e.entity_name AS __text, e.current_model_key AS __value FROM reporting.entity e JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=e.current_model_key WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND (-1 IN ($group) OR e.current_model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT e.entity_name AS __text, e.current_model_key AS __value FROM reporting.entity e JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=e.current_model_key WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND (-1 IN ($group) OR e.current_model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS modules FROM reporting.devicemodule dmod JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=dmod.model_key WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND dmod.physical_modelname<>'' AND dmod.physical_class IN (0,3,9) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR dm.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR dm.model_key IN ($devices))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dm.model_key) AS devices FROM reporting.devicemodule dmod JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=dmod.model_key WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND dmod.physical_modelname<>'' AND dmod.physical_class IN (0,3,9) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR dm.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR dm.model_key IN ($devices))

SELECT v.vendor_name AS `Vendor`, COUNT(*) AS `Modules` FROM reporting.devicemodule dmod JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=dmod.model_key JOIN reporting.vendor v ON v.vendor=dm.vendor WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND dmod.physical_modelname<>'' AND dmod.physical_class IN (0,3,9) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR dm.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR dm.model_key IN ($devices)) GROUP BY v.vendor_name ORDER BY `Modules` DESC

SELECT e.entity_name AS `Name`, dm.IP, v.vendor_name AS `Vendor`, dmod.physical_modelname AS `Module`, dmod.serial_nbr AS `Serial`, dmod.software_rev AS `Software Rev`, dmod.physical_index AS `Index` FROM reporting.devicemodule dmod JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=dmod.model_key JOIN reporting.vendor v ON v.vendor=dm.vendor JOIN reporting.entity e ON e.current_model_key=dm.model_key WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND dmod.physical_modelname<>'' AND dmod.physical_class IN (0,3,9) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR dm.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR dm.model_key IN ($devices)) ORDER BY v.vendor_name, dm.IP, dmod.physical_index
